action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if horizon == 0:
        raise ValueError("future_horizon must be at least 1")
    # Validate shapes
    if logp_call_only.shape != logp_with_result.shape or logp_no_call.shape != logp_with_result.shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    # Validate values: finite and nonpositive
    for name, mat in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not np.issubdtype(mat.dtype, np.floating):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a floating-point array")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(mat)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if np.any(mat > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be numeric")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
    raw = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    w = raw / raw.sum()
    # Compute weighted negative log probabilities
    loss_with = np.sum(w * (-logp_with_result), axis=1)
    loss_call_only = np.sum(w * (-logp_call_only), axis=1)
    loss_no_call = np.sum(w * (-logp_no_call), axis=1)
    # Stronger counterfactual baseline
    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
    margin = loss_minus - loss_with
    keep = margin >= tau_filter
    return keep, margin
